THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 01 / OCTOBER 2026
EVERYDAY THEATRE
037
48 / Varsity Scarf
Full-length look on a herringbone wood floor against a
cream plaster wall: copper-brown hair with loose side braids,
round wire glasses, a navy cardigan with mustard piping and a
small crest, a striped silk scarf tied in a large bow, a camel
pleated mini skirt with a brown belt, cream slouchy socks and tall
brown buckled boots.
49 / Navy Polo
A bright studio portrait: a long loose braid with wisps of
brown hair, thin metal glasses, a navy polo-style knit with white
stripes at the collar and hem, a blue gingham shirt layered
underneath, a navy pleated mini skirt with drawstring ties and a
soft brown suede bag with a tulip charm.
